今日任务总数·计算方式:
Today's task total = sum of hourly created counts today (creation basis).

Period-over-period baseline = sum of created at the same hour yesterday (up to current hour), ensuring fair comparison.
今日任务完成率·计算方式:
Completion rate = today's ΣcreatedSucceededCount / today's Σcreated × 100%.

The proportion of today's created orders that have been completed.

Baseline is the same hour yesterday.
在线 AGV / 总 AGV·计算方式:
Online AGV = running + idle + charging + fault (excluding offline).

Total AGV = all registered vehicles.

Snapshot read, no period-over-period.
故障 AGV 数·计算方式:
Number of vehicles currently in fault state.

Snapshot read, no period-over-period.
今日已完成任务平均耗时·计算方式:
Average duration = today's ΣcreatedSucceededDurationSeconds / ΣcreatedSucceededCount × 1000 (ms).

Average execution time of orders created and completed today.

Baseline is the same hour yesterday.
今日平均每小时完成任务数·计算方式:
Average completed tasks per hour = today's Σsucceeded ÷ hours elapsed (from 00:00 up to and including the current hour).

Average orders completed per hour today (completion basis, same as the trend chart).

Baseline is the same hour yesterday.
AGV 综合利用率·计算方式:
Utilization = runningCount / onlineVehicleCount × 100%.

Proportion of online vehicles currently running. The API has no historical busy/idle duration; an instantaneous snapshot is used as an approximation.

No period-over-period.
当前任务积压·计算方式:
Number of orders currently queued (queueOrderCount).

Snapshot read, no period-over-period.
AGV 状态分布·计算方式:
Snapshot of vehicle counts across five states: running, idle, charging, fault, offline.

Center shows online count = running + idle + charging + fault (excluding offline).
今日任务完成趋势·计算方式:
Today vs yesterday hourly comparison of completed orders (succeeded basis).

Horizontal axis up to the current hour. Yesterday's data uses the same hour progress as today for same-time comparison.
实时告警·计算方式:
Shows currently unclosed alerts (isClosed = false), up to 100 entries.

Duration = current time - occurrence time, updated every 5 seconds via polling, not from the API.
总任务数·计算方式: Total tasks = completed + failed + canceled (terminal-state basis, sum over the last {days} days).
完成率·计算方式:
Completion rate = completed / total tasks × 100%.

Completed: sum of daily completed over the last {days} days (terminal-state basis).
Total tasks = completed + failed + canceled.
失败 / 取消·计算方式:
Failed: sum of daily failed over the last {days} days.
Canceled: sum of daily canceled over the last {days} days.

Terminal-state basis.
平均执行时长·计算方式:
Average duration = last {days} days ΣcreatedSucceededDurationSeconds / ΣcreatedSucceededCount × 1000 (ms).

Average execution time of orders created and completed.
任务量趋势·计算方式:
Stacked bar chart by day for the last {days} days, split into completed / failed / canceled (terminal-state basis).

Missing days are filled with 0.
任务执行时长分布·计算方式:
Order counts bucketed by fixed duration intervals: <1min / 1-2min / 2-3min / 3-5min / 5-10min / >10min.

The API only provides bucket counts without raw duration samples; P50 / P90 cannot be calculated.
AGV 利用率排行·计算方式:
Utilization = sum of each vehicle's effective-state duration over the last {days} days / total seconds in the interval.

When the interval ends beyond the current time, the denominator only counts up to now (future time is excluded).

Effective states = EXECUTING_WORK + EXECUTING_CHARGE + EXECUTING_PARK.
利用率趋势·计算方式:
Daily utilization = total effective-state duration for the day / (seconds actually counted for that day × vehicle count for that day).

A full day inside the interval counts 86400 seconds; partial first/last days count only the covered part; today counts only up to the current time (future time is excluded).

Effective states are the same as the utilization ranking. Vehicle count is the number of vehicles included in that day's statistics. Missing days are filled with 0; records with a zero, missing, or invalid vehicle count have no utilization value.

The window is the last {days} days (controlled by the time picker above).
故障次数·计算方式:
Fault count over the last {days} days = sum of daily (closedCount + unclosedCount).

Attributed to the natural day of the alert's occurrence time (startTime).
未关闭告警数·计算方式:
Unclosed alert count over the last {days} days = sum of daily unclosedCount.

Alerts that occurred before the window and remain unclosed are not included (API does not provide this data).
告警关闭率·计算方式:
Alert closure rate over the last {days} days = sum of daily closedCount / sum of daily (closedCount + unclosedCount).

Attributed to the natural day of the alert's occurrence time (startTime).

The card is highlighted with a yellow border while any alert remains unclosed; shows "--" when there are no alerts in the window.
平均告警时长·计算方式:
Average alert duration over the last {days} days = sum of daily totalDurationSeconds / sum of daily (closedCount + unclosedCount).

Both duration and count are attributed to the natural day of the alert's occurrence time (startTime); unclosed alerts contribute their accumulated duration per the API, so this is the average alert duration rather than a strict MTTR.

Shows "--" when there are no alerts in the window.
故障趋势·计算方式:
Bar chart + frequency line by day for the last {days} days.

Daily count = closedCount + unclosedCount. Frequency (count/day) = daily count (daily bucket covers 1 day). Missing days are filled with 0.
单机故障排行 TOP10·计算方式:
Top 10 AGVs with the most faults on the specified date (today).

The API only supports single-day rankings; interval aggregation is not supported.

The denominator is not multiplied by the vehicle count, so with multiple vehicles the result may exceed 100% (approx. the average number of vehicles executing tasks simultaneously).

When the range end is later than now, the denominator is capped at the current time (future time not counted).
平均交管时长·计算方式:
Traffic Hold (TRAFFIC) total duration ÷ number of vehicles.

Vehicles without this state count as 0 in the average.
平均执行时长（车辆状态）·计算方式:
EXECUTING_WORK total duration ÷ number of vehicles.

Vehicles without this state count as 0 in the average.
平均故障时长·计算方式:
ERROR total duration ÷ number of vehicles.

Vehicles without this state count as 0 in the average. The card is highlighted with a red border when greater than 0.
各状态总时长占比·计算方式:
Donut chart of total duration aggregated by state across vehicles.

Only states with duration > 0 are shown.
各状态总时长排行·计算方式: Total duration aggregated by state across vehicles (hours), sorted ascending so the longest state is on top.
车辆 × 状态 时长堆叠·计算方式:
One stacked bar per vehicle by state (hours). All vehicles are shown initially.

Drag the slider handles to zoom or its middle area to pan. You can also hold Ctrl and scroll to zoom. Hover over a bar for the full vehicle name and state durations; click a legend item to toggle that state.

State order follows the report state enum; colors are fixed semantic state colors.
单车辆状态分布·计算方式:
State duration share of the selected vehicle.

Switch vehicles via the dropdown at the top right; defaults to the first vehicle.
车辆总时长排行·计算方式: Sum of all state durations per vehicle (hours), sorted descending.
